operations.old:
KEEP Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP and knowing all current activities of one actual faction for one minute. NEW choose an exact known existing faction identity and one perceived creature within 120 feet and line of effect nominated as its current-member reference. A real current membership link is required to establish the institutional reading, not positive standing, rank, badge ownership or the member's consent. A costume, former membership or assertion is not that link. CORRECTION/explicit paid-reference boundary: public preflight validates the nominated visible creature, known faction and ordinary casting conditions; hidden membership, protected identification and the existence of readable activity are resolved only after legal payment. A false, undefined or wholly protected qualifying reference establishes no feed and provides no hidden reason or refund. No free pre-cast membership oracle is created. A known nonexistent/invented faction is not a new legal institution merely because it was named.

NEW nonconcentration 60-second private institutional feed. At successful establishment, give a structured register of every actual current institutional project, order being carried out, patrol, meeting, transaction, covert operation and other coordinated faction task. Each readable activity appears once with its actual current objective, participants/roles, location, stage and immediate activity. Include actual distant branches and faction business, including unreported or unauthorized work genuinely using the institution's office, resources or orders. Do not reduce this promise to the nearby reference, one agent, public reports or an arbitrary numerical project cap. Independent personal/family activity, private unrelated thoughts and unrelated third-party business remain outside it. Shared operations disclose this faction's real participation, not the other institution's whole dossier. A planned task already being actively organized can be current activity; an uncommitted imagined future is not.

Range and originating line of effect admit the local reference; they do not clip the institution-wide remote register. This is an expressly NEW institutional-information reach choice, not a remote visual sensor, targeting origin, route or transport permission. Subject/site protections that actually prevent this Divination/rank-7 inquiry still apply; ordinary distance or a remote building wall alone is not a new veto on abstract institutional facts. No plane origin, cross-plane travel rule or sealed-setting meaning is authored here; an actual more specific source barrier retains its literal scope. The reference's later movement, departure or death does not switch the selected institution. Membership/organizational continuity are actual current histories, not guessed labels; no successor faction is silently selected after the original ceases to exist.

During the minute update material beginnings, changes and endings when they actually occur, using canonical ordered timestamps. Real remote/unreported facts can be readable even if no leader has learned them. Protection of one agent's identity does not erase independent readable activity; equally, its protected identity/location cannot be reconstructed by relabeling it as faction data. Omit existence-protected activities entirely without diagnostic counts/placeholders; otherwise independently readable fields remain useful and protected/undefined fields are Indeterminate. The source summary is no guarantee that undefined events or participants must be invented to make the register complete.

Large finite registers use a hierarchy retaining every readable activity rather than silently sampling them. Reviewing or communicating details takes ordinary time and grants no extra Actions, automatic checks, command, membership, standing, authority or access. Actual caster death ends this private feed; incapacity alone prevents receiving usable notices while it lasts, without a backfill. Suppression similarly pauses receipt, not the original clock. On lawful return before expiry provide the current readable register, not missed past changes as historical disclosures. At expiry/dispel the feed ends; previously received knowledge is not erased but never self-updates. Equivalent overlapping casts do not reroll protected/undefined fields. Faction Divination, Faction Insight, pending Faction Destiny and pending Supreme Omniscience remain distinct, with their own source permissions and review labels. No reputation score, saved key/absence/null/version, background standing or faction-action/24-hour checkpoint is changed by this knowledge.
